normalization_audit.project: CuteCut Pro - Text Normalization and Indexing Audit

A_current_vad.diacritic_handling: Ignored physically by audio engine. Boundaries are mapped proportionally based solely on character-length ratios.
A_current_vad.reversibility_to_tanzil: 100% reversible since it uses the exact unmodified Tanzil text structure.

B_model_b_wav2vec2.expected_text: Fully stripped Arabic script (No Tashkeel, no Harakat, simplified Alef/Yaa/Waw).
B_model_b_wav2vec2.diacritic_handling: Strictly stripped. The model's token vocabulary does not contain Arabic diacritics. It relies on a flat set of 38-42 basic Arabic characters.
B_model_b_wav2vec2.reversibility_to_tanzil: MODERATE RISK. Stripping diacritics makes it difficult to map the predicted character logits back to the exact positions of the diacritized Tanzil Uthmani text. It requires a complex alignment search to re-insert diacritics post-decoding.

C_cpfair_quran_align.diacritic_handling: Preserved. The C++ parser maps diacritized words directly to a custom phonetic dictionary containing explicit phoneme expansions.
C_cpfair_quran_align.reversibility_to_tanzil: 100% reversible since word tokens are split strictly by whitespace based on the original Tanzil file.
